clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, Alamar Grimm gives the Tainted Memorandum to novice gnome warlocks. His note urges them to leave old paths behind and seek power through the dark arts.

At Anvilmar, fel practitioners are neither celebrated nor widely trusted. Alamar Grimm gives the Tainted Memorandum to young gnomes who study forbidden arts. He rejects the Holy Light and ordinary weapons, pointing to Gnomeregan’s fall as proof that old ways and tinkering failed their people. Grimm sees reliance on dwarven charity as a dead end. He urges gnomes to claim undeniable power and summon minions who will obey without question, if they are to secure their own future.
